_comment: Tavily search API templates. Tavily is a web search API optimized for AI agents.

tavily_python_env.name: tavily_python_env
tavily_python_env.description: Inject TAVILY_API_KEY for the Python SDK
tavily_python_env.cli: harness vault template add tavily/search --name tavily_python_env --env '{"TAVILY_API_KEY": "$value"}'

tavily_curl_bearer.name: tavily_curl_bearer
tavily_curl_bearer.description: Wrap curl with Bearer token for Tavily REST API
tavily_curl_bearer.cli: harness vault template add tavily/search --name tavily_curl_bearer --wrapper "curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer \$value' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' {original}"
